name: RuView Presence
description: Presence-aware agent behavior powered by RuView WiFi sensing. Detects user presence via WiFi CSI and adapts agent behavior — queuing messages when away, delivering digests on return.

ruviewUrl.description: RuView API base URL (no trailing slash)

apiKey.description: Optional Bearer token if RuView auth is enabled (env RUVIEW_API_KEY)

confidenceThreshold.description: Min confidence to count as present (0-1)

debounceCount.description: Consecutive empty reads before marking away

maxQueueSize.description: Max queued events while away (oldest non-urgent dropped first)

ruviewUrl.label: RuView URL
ruviewUrl.help: Base URL of the RuView sensing server (default: http://localhost:3000). Example: http://192.168.1.20:3000

apiKey.label: RuView API Key
apiKey.help: Only needed if you set RUVIEW_API_TOKEN on the server. Leave blank for default unauthenticated local setup.

pollIntervalMs.label: Poll Interval (ms)
pollIntervalMs.help: How often to check presence on heartbeat, in milliseconds (default: 10000, min 1000).

confidenceThreshold.label: Confidence Threshold
confidenceThreshold.help: Minimum detection confidence to count as present (default: 0.3).

debounceCount.label: Debounce Count
debounceCount.help: Consecutive empty checks before marking user as away (default: 2).

enableDigest.label: Enable Digest
enableDigest.help: Deliver a summary when the user returns after being away (default: true).

enableZoneAwareness.label: Enable Zone Awareness
enableZoneAwareness.help: Track which zone the user is in for smarter behavior (default: false).

maxQueueSize.label: Max Queue Size
maxQueueSize.help: Maximum queued events while away (default: 100). Oldest non-urgent items are dropped first.
